description: Clone of exp007 with ONLY the LUT geometry changed: tables_per_head 256->512 (n_anchor_pairs stays 6, K=2^6=64 rows). Everything else identical to exp007/the locked config (single-head HyperplaneMHL FFN, n_heads=1, n_outputs=384, hard forward, random init +0.001 noise, LUT bf16 / hyperplanes fp32, hybrid Lion+Adam-no-wd optimizer routed by parameter identity, grad_clip 1.0, .float() before residual, 16000 steps, eval_every 200, seed 1). Doubling tph again doubles the LUT weights vs exp007 -> expected ~111M params (~3x exp001; confirm actual built count at launch). Compares vs exp001 anchor 1.20144, exp006 1.2645, exp007 1.2405.
